versions.changelog:
subject-library 1.0.0

- Initial release providing professional A-share theme (题材) analysis based on the 爱投顾「题材库」 data.
- Supports theme list browsing, single-theme detail analysis, stock-theme relationship lookup, and heat rankings.
- Integrates real-time core stock market data from multiple sources (Tencent, 东方财富, AKShare) with proper source attribution.
- Includes web search supplement for up-to-date market insights and analyst opinions.
- Outputs all findings in structured Markdown reports, with transparency when data is insufficient.
